title: Distinguish Yoke telemetry from customer domain data
when: Explaining collection, retention or investigating event data
need: Read the product telemetry contract and destination. Do not generalize Yoke analytics rules to an application event store installed or built in a customer project. Data provenance, actor attribution and query-time linkage need accurate audience-specific explanation.
surface: Public Events article describes universe-local collectors, redaction, attribution and visitor links; sidebar makes article reachable.
gap: No full privacy/data-flow audit was performed. Reconcile the broad no-personal-data wording with documented actor/browser linkage rather than repeat an unchecked blanket claim.
